sentiment.rationale: The document reports a mixed quarter with net sales down 1.5% and comparable sales down 2.5%, but adjusted EPS of $2.44 was in line with expectations and slightly above last year. Forward guidance for 2026 is modest: net sales growth around 2%, operating income margin rate approximately 20 basis points higher, and GAAP/Adjusted EPS of $7.50 to $8.50, which is below the full-year 2025 adjusted EPS of $7.57 at the midpoint. Management expresses confidence in momentum, citing a healthy sales increase in February, but the guidance is not raised materially and remains cautious, resulting in a slightly positive but subdued score.

summary.revenue: Fourth quarter net sales of $30.5 billion, down 1.5% from Q4 2024. Full-year net sales decreased 1.7% to $104.8 billion.
summary.eps: Fourth quarter GAAP EPS of $2.30, Adjusted EPS of $2.44 (up 1.5% from $2.41 last year). Full-year GAAP EPS of $8.13, Adjusted EPS of $7.57 (down 14.5% from $8.86 last year).
summary.guidance: Full-year 2026: net sales growth around 2%, operating income margin rate approximately 20 basis points higher than 2025's 4.6% adjusted margin, GAAP and Adjusted EPS of $7.50 to $8.50. Q1 2026 EPS expected flat to up slightly from last year's $1.30.
summary.margin: Fourth quarter gross margin rate 26.6% (up from 26.2% last year). Adjusted operating income margin rate 4.8% (up from 4.7% last year). Full-year gross margin rate 27.9% (down from 28.2% last year). Full-year adjusted operating income margin rate 4.6% (down from 5.2% last year).
key_risks: Full-year net sales decreased 1.7% and comparable sales decreased 2.6%.
Full-year GAAP EPS declined 8.2% and Adjusted EPS declined 14.5%.
Full-year gross margin rate declined from 28.2% to 27.9% due to higher markdowns and purchase order cancellation costs.
Net interest expense increased due to higher average debt levels.
Forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties described in the Form 10-K.
key_opportunities: Non-merchandise sales grew over 25%, with membership revenue more than doubling, double-digit growth from Roundel, and over 30% growth in marketplace.
Same-day delivery powered by Target Circle 360 grew over 30%.
Sales and traffic trends accelerated in the last two months of the quarter.
Target saw a healthy, positive sales increase in February, serving as an important milestone on the path back to growth.
Fourth quarter gross margin rate improved to 26.6% from 26.2%, reflecting lower inventory shrink, lower supply chain and digital fulfillment costs, and growth in advertising and other revenues.
Adjusted operating income in Q4 was slightly above last year.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: CEO Michael Fiddelke states, 'I'm incredibly proud of how our team navigated through a challenging year... reinforcing my confidence in the momentum we're building and the future we're creating together.'
